name: ark-play
description: Ark Play gameplay tools: compact views and explicit actions over the game site connection.

interface.longDescription: Play solo games on a trusted Stronghold Protocol site using compact views, explicit actions and public card information. Requires Node.js 22 or later and a configured game site. Recording, storage and authentication are controlled by the site.
defaultPrompt: 用 ark_start 开一局深渊，根据局面和公开说明决策，玩到自然结束。
